messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are you feeling this week? Any blood pressure readings to share?
148 over 91 this morning. Also I'm almost out of my metoprolol — doc says I need a new script but the pharmacy in Williston is 45 miles away and I don't have a way to get there before I run out.

Got it — I've logged that reading and noted the metoprolol situation. Running low on a blood pressure medication is something our care team needs to know about, so I've sent this to a nurse right now.
Can they send it to a closer pharmacy? There's one in Grassy Butte but I'm not sure if they take my insurance either.

I'm not able to handle pharmacy transfers or insurance questions — that's outside what I can do. But the nurse will have all of this context when they reach out, so that's exactly the kind of thing to work through with them.
Alright. Any idea when they'll call?
The median response time right now is 31 hours. I've got your next regular check-in scheduled for next week, but text anytime if symptoms come up or you get another reading you're unsure about.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
